questions.text: When did Emmeline Pankhurst set up the women’s Franchise League, which fought to get the vote in local elections for married women?
questions.explanation: Emmeline Pankhurst was born in Manchester in 1858. She set up the women’s Franchise League in1889, which fought to get the vote in local elections for married women. In 1903 she helped found the Women’s Social and Political Union (WSPU).
